cohort: 2 52 198 singleton births of at least 34 weeks in 29 countries from the WHO Multi-Country Survey on Maternal and Newborn Health (2010-2011)
finding: PLCD was associated with reduced perinatal mortality and non-significantly with increased late preterm birth, while LI was associated with increases in both late preterm birth and, in less-developed countries, perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: PLCD was associated with reduced perinatal mortality and non-significantly with increased late preterm birth.
